title: Story premise EDU097: The Photograph Loses Its Calendar
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (consumer digital literacy). Hook: What if this picture is real but the caption is wrong? Takeaway/theme: Authentic media can still be presented with misleading context.
description: A viewer wants to judge a dramatic claim, but a real-looking image arrives without its original date or context. The story follows source tracing until the image’s earlier setting changes the interpretation.
